brief.title: Connect a new harness
brief.plain_summary: Configure the harness with its own credential store, then confirm from inside the harness that discovery and whoami match the issued scope.
brief.outcome: A private connection record, or blocked with the one missing setting.

harness_label.description: A plain label for the harness, such as its product name.

output_store.description: Store for the produced private nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Private nouns are readable only by the key that wrote them. Include each produced value in output.artifacts[].value with its pin so the requester can verify it through the task result. Never widen visibility or allowlist other surfaces.

outcome_meanings.connected: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The connection record validates against template.connection's schema.
discovery lists claim, heartbeat, put_record, get_record, submit and my_audit as present.
No credential appears in the record, the output or the execution report.

required: Follow the connection guide for the harness's transport. Keep credentials in the harness's own credential store. Never put a key in a brief, an output, a log, a noun or a conversation.
From inside the harness, run discovery and whoami. Record which expected tools were found.
Record the harness's exact version string as the harness reports it.
Use a local Tessera service by default. Use a shared hosted deployment only when its health is confirmed and the owner authorized this run there.

execution.inference_allowance: Existing authorized worker allowance only. This template grants no provider credit, spending authority or server inference.
execution.network: Only the assigned Tessera deployment's discovery and identity routes.

instantiation.rule: Replace each slot with exact NounRef pins, set the params, then recompute the idempotency key with scripts/build_packs.py --instantiate. Enqueue only with your own grants in a queue your owner assigned.

execution_report.purpose: Lets later runs of this template be fingerprinted and compared. It is worker reported, not proof.

summaries.problem: One sentence: what this run was asked to resolve.
summaries.input: One sentence: which pinned inputs were read.
summaries.solution: One sentence: what was produced or why the outcome was no_change, unknown or blocked.

usage.reason: Template only. Replace with measured counters or keep null with a reason.

fill_rules: Copy contract.input_schema and contract.output_schema unchanged, so every run of this template shares one shape fingerprint.
Add context_hash, environment_hash and toolchain_hash as lowercase SHA-256 digests when known; all five contract fields together allow exact matching.
Name the exact harness version, provider and model. Deterministic or human work records the model name as none.
Put what went wrong in an error block and in output.run_notes.went_wrong. The version-1 report has no fields for what went right, next steps or ideas, so those go in output.run_notes.
Leave token counts null with a reason unless the harness or provider measured them.

dimension_basis.reason: Tessera requires these axes, so each is set to its lowest value and the tier is unverified. No quality is claimed. Replace them only with measured values and the evidence that produced them.

brief.title: Run the scoped lifecycle end to end
brief.plain_summary: The harness under test claims this very task and performs claim, read, heartbeat, write, read back, submit and audit, recording each result.
brief.outcome: A private run record whether the run passed or failed; lifecycle_passed is true only when every required step passed.

connection.description: Pin of the connection record for this harness.

run_probes.description: Also run the two negative probes.

output_store.description: Store for the produced private nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

acceptance_checks.check: The run record validates against template.run-record's schema.
Every checklist step id appears exactly once.
The read-pinned step's evidence shows the computed digest equal to the pin.
harness.exact_version, provider.name and model.name are filled, using none where no model was used.
lifecycle_passed is true exactly when every required step passed.

required: Claim this task with the harness under test; the claim is step three of the checklist.
Perform every checklist step in order and record pass, fail or skip with evidence.
On a failure, follow the recovery playbook; never switch keys or deployments.
Submit with an Idempotency-Key and an execution report naming the exact harness version, provider and model.
Keep credentials in the harness's own credential store. Never put a key in a brief, an output, a log, a noun or a conversation.

required_capabilities: claim, heartbeat, put_record, get_record, submit and my_audit within the assigned scope

brief.outcome: A private diagnosis; no effect is retried by this verb.
